mainEntity.name: Do homes in Denver and the south metro need anything special before tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile installation in the Denver metro area is common year-round, but local conditions still matter. Basements, slabs, and homes with moisture or temperature swings need careful prep, so ask whether the installer checks the floor type and moisture before starting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Denver-area homes often need careful subfloor and moisture prep, especially on slabs or in basements. Ask for moisture testing and the right underlayment before installation.
